title: Energetic Greek Soya Dolmades
description: A pungent and chewy post-workout Greek dish featuring soya milk, cooked in a clay pot, and sugar-free friendly, formed into dolmades.
instructions: Rinse the vine leaves and blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked rice, chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped fresh parsley.
Add the soya milk, lemon juice, and olive oil to the bowl and mix well.
Lay a vine leaf flat and place a tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining vine leaves and filling.
Place the dolmades in a clay pot and cover them with water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the dolmades warm or at room temperature.
